Features.metaDescription: Everything the SaleLinx Chrome extension does, what it costs, and what is coming next. Crosslist, relist, refresh, and restock across Depop and Vinted from one panel.

hero.title: The product, the price, and the roadmap.
hero.description: Scroll for the features, jump to pricing when you're ready, or skim the roadmap to see what we're shipping next. The tabs follow you down the page.

sectionHeader.title: Everything the extension does, grouped by what you actually do with it.

ctaSection.title: Start in the browser you already sell from.

listings.title: Listings & inventory
listings.blurb: One dashboard shows every listing from both shops, merged, sortable, and backed up. Link your Depop and Vinted accounts once and the panel is ready on every page.

dashboard.label: Unified listings dashboard
dashboard.detail: Both shops in one grid, merged by title, sortable across columns.

linkAccounts.label: Link accounts once
linkAccounts.detail: Session auto-detected from the browser; nothing to re-enter.

backup.label: Encrypted cloud backup
backup.detail: Supabase-backed listing store with client-side AES encryption on linked credentials.

sync.label: Settings sync across devices
sync.detail: Move to a second laptop and your configuration follows.

multilanguage.label: Multi-language UI
multilanguage.detail: English, French, Spanish and German, with light and dark themes.

crosslisting.title: Crosslisting
crosslisting.blurb: Write the listing once, post it to both marketplaces. Categories, sizes, conditions and brands are translated for you, and the Depop shop layout tool lives in the same panel.

bidirectional.label: Bi-directional crosslister
bidirectional.detail: Depop to Vinted and Vinted to Depop, with form auto-fill on the target marketplace.

autoMap.label: Auto-mapped taxonomies
autoMap.detail: Categories, sizes, conditions and brands translated between platforms.

csvImport.label: CSV inventory import
csvImport.detail: Bulk-load an existing inventory with automatic field mapping.

shopDesigner.label: Shop Designer
shopDesigner.detail: Drag-and-drop layout tool for the Depop shop profile.

visibility.title: Visibility & audience
visibility.blurb: Keep listings near the top of search and bring relevant users to your shop. Refresh runs on a schedule you set; the follow bot has five ways to target the right accounts.

refresher.label: Listing refresher
refresher.detail: Re-saves listings bottom-up so your shop order is preserved.

scheduler.label: Auto-refresh scheduler
scheduler.detail: Runs on 4, 6, 8, 12 or 24-hour intervals via chrome.alarms.

followBot.label: Follow / unfollow bot
followBot.detail: Target a user's followers, following, your buyers, review-givers or likers.

filters.label: Blacklist and whitelist
filters.detail: Case-insensitive matching so specific accounts are always skipped or always kept.

deadStock.label: Dead-stock detector
deadStock.detail: Classifies stale listings and suggests actions.

activityLog.label: Real-time activity log
activityLog.detail: Filter by feature or level, pause and stop at any time, export to JSON.

sales.title: Sales & messaging
sales.blurb: Offers, buyer messages and shipping labels in one inbox across both marketplaces. Rules handle the repetitive replies so you only touch the conversations that matter.

offersInbox.label: Unified offers inbox
offersInbox.detail: Accept, decline or counter offers from both marketplaces in one place.

autoOffers.label: Auto-offers
autoOffers.detail: Rule-based counter or accept replies on incoming offers.

messages.label: Unified messages
messages.detail: Conversations inbox that merges Depop and Vinted threads.

shipping.label: Shipping labels
shipping.detail: Download and merge PDF labels for batched fulfilment.

relister.label: Relister
relister.detail: Recreate listings with tweaked photos and title, then delete the original to refresh search visibility.

sectionHeader.title: Pick a plan. Switch any time. Cancel any time.
sectionHeader.body: Every plan ships the same extension. Higher tiers raise monthly caps and unlock the heavier automations like auto-offers and restocker.
